info.title: Contoso Insurance Claims Operations API
info.description: Read-only Contoso Insurance claims-system records for the claims review agent: claims, policies, customer claim history and vehicles. The API returns stored business facts only. It does not interpret policy language, decide coverage, compare or assess claim evidence, score risk, or recommend claim actions. Dates are ISO 8601. Dates of loss are local to the loss location; timestamps ending in Z are UTC. Each response includes recordsAsOf, the time of the data snapshot. Errors are returned as HTTP 200 with an error object so the agent can explain them. All data is synthetic; Contoso Insurance is fictional.

get.description: Returns the stored claim record: customer, policy and vehicle references, loss details, damage reported at first notice of loss, other parties, police involvement, status, the documents and photographs received (evidence references), the selected repair facility and the estimate of record reference. Documents are listed by reference; their content is not returned. IDs are case-insensitive; surrounding spaces are ignored. Failures are returned with HTTP 200 and an error object instead of data (no other fields), so that the agent can read and explain them. Possible error codes: CLAIM_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_REQUEST, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Only SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is retryable.

200.description: Claim record and selected repair facility, or an error.

schema.description: On success, the data fields. On failure, only error.

recordsAsOf.description: UTC time at which this snapshot of the claims system was taken. Statuses and dates are as of this time.

claim.description: Claim record as stored in the claims system.

claimId.description: Claim ID, format CLM-nnnnn. Archived claims use AC-yyyy-nnnnn.

claimType.description: Claim type as recorded at first notice of loss.

causeOfLoss.description: Cause of loss as recorded at first notice of loss.

lossDate.description: Date of loss, local to lossTimeZone.

lossTime.description: Approximate time of loss (HH:MM, 24-hour), local to lossTimeZone.

lossTimeZone.description: IANA time zone of the loss location.

description.description: Location as described in the report.

reportedAt.description: UTC time the claim was reported to Contoso Insurance.

reportChannel.description: Channel used to report the claim.

description.description: The policyholder's description of the loss, as reported.

reportedDamage.description: Damage to the insured vehicle as reported by the policyholder at first notice of loss.

areas.description: Damaged areas selected by the reporter.

vehicleDrivable.description: Whether the vehicle was reported as drivable.

otherParties.description: Other parties involved in the loss. Empty when none were reported.

items.description: Another party involved in the loss.

role.description: Role of the party, for example Other driver.

policeReport.description: Police involvement as reported. This records whether a report was made; whether a police report document has been received is shown in documents.

reportedToPolice.description: Whether the loss was reported to police.

repairFacilityId.description: ID of the repair facility selected for the claim, format RF-nnn.

estimate.description: Reference to the repair estimate of record. The estimate document itself is listed in documents.

estimateId.description: Estimate ID assigned by the repair facility.

repairFacilityId.description: Repair facility that wrote the estimate.

grossAmount.description: Estimate grand total before the deductible. US dollars.

documents.description: Documents and photographs received for the claim, in the order received. Empty when none have been received.

items.description: A document or photograph received for the claim.

title.description: Document title as indexed in the claim file.

receivedAt.description: UTC time the document was received.

settlement.description: Payment recorded on a closed claim; null when no payment was recorded.

settledAmount.description: Agreed loss amount before the deductible. US dollars.

closedDate.description: Date the claim was closed; null while open.

closureReason.description: Recorded closure reason; null while open.

createdAt.description: UTC time the claim record was created.

lastUpdatedAt.description: UTC time the claim record was last updated.

repairFacility.description: Repair facility selected for the claim; null when none has been selected.

error.description: Present only when the operation failed. When present, no data fields are returned. Do not substitute or invent the requested information.

httpStatus.description: Conventional HTTP status for this error (400, 404 or 503).

retryable.description: True only when retrying the same request later may succeed (SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE).

get.description: Returns policy facts: policyholder, status, current term dates, cancellation details, listed drivers, policy-level coverages and limits, and each listed vehicle with its dates on the policy, vehicle-level coverages and deductibles and loss payee. vehicleDetails identifies each listed vehicle. The record states what the policy contains; it does not determine whether a loss is covered. IDs are case-insensitive; surrounding spaces are ignored. Failures are returned with HTTP 200 and an error object instead of data (no other fields), so that the agent can read and explain them. Possible error codes: POLICY_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_REQUEST, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Only SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is retryable.

200.description: Policy record with policyholder and listed-vehicle identification, or an error.

schema.description: On success, the data fields. On failure, only error.

recordsAsOf.description: UTC time at which this snapshot of the claims system was taken. Statuses and dates are as of this time.

policy.description: Personal auto policy record. Coverage and deductible facts are as stated on the declarations page; this record does not interpret them for any particular loss.

status.description: Policy status as of recordsAsOf. Expired: the term ended without renewal. Cancelled: see cancellation.

ratingState.description: Two-letter state in which the policy is written.

inceptionDate.description: Date the policy was first issued.

termMonths.description: Length of the current term in months (6 or 12).

termEffectiveDate.description: Start of the current (or last) policy term, inclusive, 12:01 AM local time.

termExpirationDate.description: End of the current (or last) policy term, 12:01 AM local time.

cancellation.description: Cancellation details; null when the policy has not been cancelled.

effectiveDate.description: Date the cancellation took effect, 12:01 AM local time.

termPremium.description: Premium for the current term. US dollars.

licenseState.description: State that issued the driver's license.

policyCoverages.description: Coverages that apply to the policy as a whole.

coverageName.description: Coverage name as shown on the declarations page.

deductible.description: Deductible for this coverage; null when the coverage has no deductible. US dollars.

limits.description: Limits for this coverage. Empty when none are stated on the declarations page.

vehicles.description: Vehicles listed on the policy, including vehicles since removed. Vehicle-level coverages and deductibles are recorded per vehicle.

addedDate.description: Date the vehicle was added to the policy.

removedDate.description: Date the vehicle was removed from the policy; null if still listed.

lossPayee.description: Lienholder or lessor recorded as loss payee; null if none.

coverages.description: Vehicle-level coverages. Empty when only liability coverages apply to this vehicle.

coverageName.description: Coverage name as shown on the declarations page.

deductible.description: Deductible for this coverage; null when the coverage has no deductible. US dollars.

limits.description: Limits for this coverage. Empty when none are stated on the declarations page.

vehicleDetails.description: Identification of each vehicle in policy.vehicles, in the same order.

error.description: Present only when the operation failed. When present, no data fields are returned. Do not substitute or invent the requested information.

httpStatus.description: Conventional HTTP status for this error (400, 404 or 503).

retryable.description: True only when retrying the same request later may succeed (SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE).

get.description: Returns every claim on record for the customer, open and closed, from the current claims system and from the archive of the previous system, most recent date of loss first. The list includes any claim currently being reviewed. Amounts are shown where a payment was recorded. A customer with no claims returns an empty claims list and claimCount 0; that is not an error. Prior claims are factual history only. IDs are case-insensitive; surrounding spaces are ignored. Failures are returned with HTTP 200 and an error object instead of data (no other fields), so that the agent can read and explain them. Possible error codes: CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_REQUEST, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Only SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is retryable.

200.description: Customer claim history, or an error.

schema.description: On success, the data fields. On failure, only error.

recordsAsOf.description: UTC time at which this snapshot of the claims system was taken. Statuses and dates are as of this time.

claims.description: Claims on record, most recent date of loss first.

items.description: One claim on the customer's record.

claimId.description: Claim ID, format CLM-nnnnn. Archived claims use AC-yyyy-nnnnn.

recordSource.description: Where the record is held. Claims system: current claims system (use get_claim for detail). Archive: closed claims migrated from the previous system; summary only.

reportedDate.description: Date the claim was reported, local to the loss location.

settledAmount.description: Agreed loss amount before the deductible; null if no payment recorded. US dollars.

deductibleApplied.description: Deductible applied; null if no payment recorded. US dollars.

totalPaid.description: Amount paid; null if no payment recorded. US dollars.

error.description: Present only when the operation failed. When present, no data fields are returned. Do not substitute or invent the requested information.

httpStatus.description: Conventional HTTP status for this error (400, 404 or 503).

retryable.description: True only when retrying the same request later may succeed (SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE).

get.description: Returns the vehicle record (synthetic VIN, year, make, model, trim, body style, color, ownership, use, garaging and recorded equipment), its owner, and every policy listing for the vehicle with its dates and coverage codes. listedOnActivePolicy is true when the vehicle is currently listed (no removedDate) on a policy whose status is Active as of recordsAsOf. IDs are case-insensitive; surrounding spaces are ignored. Failures are returned with HTTP 200 and an error object instead of data (no other fields), so that the agent can read and explain them. Possible error codes: VEHICLE_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_REQUEST, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Only SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is retryable.

200.description: Vehicle record, owner and policy listings, or an error.

schema.description: On success, the data fields. On failure, only error.

recordsAsOf.description: UTC time at which this snapshot of the claims system was taken. Statuses and dates are as of this time.

acquiredDate.description: Date the owner acquired the vehicle.

disposedDate.description: Date the owner disposed of the vehicle; null if still owned.

lienholder.description: Lienholder or lessor; null when owned outright.

garaging.description: Where the vehicle is principally garaged.

equipment.description: Factory equipment recorded for the vehicle.

listedOnActivePolicy.description: True when the vehicle is listed, without a removedDate, on a policy with status Active.

policies.description: Every policy on which the vehicle is or was listed. Empty if none.

addedDate.description: Date the vehicle was added to the policy.

removedDate.description: Date removed; null if still listed.

coverageCodes.description: Vehicle-level coverage codes on this listing.

error.description: Present only when the operation failed. When present, no data fields are returned. Do not substitute or invent the requested information.

httpStatus.description: Conventional HTTP status for this error (400, 404 or 503).

retryable.description: True only when retrying the same request later may succeed (SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE).
